title: 第十九章 情报（修）
content_zh: 作为镇守者秘密培养的卧底，夜梦知道自己是做什么的。自幼父母双亡，牺牲在与唯我正教战斗的战场上，那时候，她才两岁。她从两岁半，就参加了暗殿集训。与夜梦一同在这个基地参加秘密集训的，一共四百个差不多大小的孩子。到后来，一些转职成为杀手，一些转职成为刺客，还有一些干脆淘汰，或者开始做内勤，或者送进了守卫军团或者进入了一些职能部门。到最后，只剩下十五个。残酷的淘汰制度，已经不能用大浪淘沙来形容了。十五个人有男有女，其中三人出去执行任务，已经牺牲。而夜梦便是这十五个人中的第一個。资质最高，掌握业务最熟练，隐蔽性最高。因为资质特别优秀，一直在重点集训，各种教导；当然，也是因为这丫头长相有些太妖孽的原因。眼睛太大了。而且还有点天然的婴儿肥。睁眼就开始展露呆萌。哪怕是心里精明的要死，但表面上却也让人有一种呆呆的懵懵的萌萌的感觉。让任何人一看都是这小姑娘呆呆的，懵懵的，脑子肯定不大好使的样子。却又天生惹人怜爱。眼睛微微下垂，那就是一个祸国殃民的妖精；但睁开眼睛，瞬间从妖精变身呆萌小萝莉。谁见了都想要在脸上捏一把。这样的材料，武道资质又超群，根本不舍得放出去。直到这一次，高层认为可以试试了。而范天条打报告，一听，只是一个刚入教的小虾米，而且实力这么低，安全系数很高啊。于是选择这么一个相对安全的任务，放到了方彻身边，先历练一下。毕竟方彻这种线，利用价值一般。因为阶位太低，才武士，而且才十七……看看有点收获就有，没有收获的话到时候收了网也就罢了。等于有枣无枣打三杆子，让夜梦来锻炼一下。但夜梦现在直接有些迷了。任务太顺利了啊！这个方彻几乎就是给了自己做卧底最宽松的环境，而且他的理由，都是无懈可击！给自己的感觉乃是：的确是这样。确实应该是这样！所以夜梦现在虽然没睡着，也如同做梦一般。迷糊。“已成功卧底方侧。”“方彻修为武士五品左右，资质极好；修炼速度很快，以此速度下去，一月后的镇守武院入院大比，前十稳妥；前三有望。”“方彻欲要培植我练功，以期未来臂助。”“……”很简单的以密语写了几条，就送了出去。……接下来，方彻开始练功，不仅他自己勤奋，还督促夜梦一起，要求更加严格。甚至，到了一种变态的地步。但凡有一点不标准，非打即骂，满口的‘废物、果然不堪造就、什么素质、浪费我粮食！’……夜梦敢怒而不敢言，又不敢暴露真实水平，忍气吞声拼命练，被骂的头上一层层起疙瘩。“剑都不会拿！”“修炼啊看我干什么？”“三天了功法还不入门，废物！”“站也不会站，走也不会走，跑更加不会！你干什么吃的？你以为是在做侍女只是斟茶倒水吗？”“……”只要方彻休息时间，夜梦的噩梦就到来了！那张嘴如同毒蛇一般，往外喷射着各种恶毒的攻击人的语言。冰冷恶毒。“就你这资质，再不进步，除了生孩子也没啥别的用处了！”“胸不高屁股不翘身上没二两肉一身的排骨当小妾都硌人……”“再这么笨我就把你卖入青楼！”夜梦心头烈火熊熊，好多次忍不住暴起将这家伙一巴掌拍死。这嘴太特么毒了！气的心里要爆炸，但是却是本能的跟着方彻的指挥去做，一天下来，腰酸腿痛脑子发涨，恩，脑子发涨是被骂的。到了晚上，服侍方彻睡觉后，夜梦才开始收拾一天的收获。然后，脑海中掠过一个个动作。然后最终，在拔剑动作上停住。突然有点惊讶。仔细回想自己原本的动作，再对比现在的动作，在脑海中形成一个个拔剑的身影来对比。骇然发现，这样拔剑，竟然比自己原本的动作更加舒畅，而且，拔剑出鞘的同时，就具备了杀伤力，若是修炼到一定地步，拔剑的剑气，就足以直接杀伤对手！而自己原本的习惯动作，却做不到！虽然只是一式；但若是自己恢复现在自己真实实力出剑的话，战力几乎就因为这一式，提升了两倍以上的出其不意的效果！而杀伤力提升更多。“这怎么可能？”无形中，夜梦突然有些迷惘。决定明天再看看。难道，这才是最正确的？或者是，前人都没发现的？我之前练的，其实并不是最正确的？
content_en: As an undercover agent secretly trained by the Guardian, Ye Meng knows what he does.Both her parents died when she was young, and they died on the battlefield fighting against the Solipsism. At that time, she was only two years old.She has participated in the Dark Hall training since she was two and a half years old.There were a total of four hundred children of about the same size participating in the secret training at this base with Ye Meng.Later, some changed jobs and became assassins, some changed jobs and became assassins, and some were simply eliminated, or started working as internal staff, or were sent to the guard corps or entered some functional departments.By the end, only fifteen were left.The cruel elimination system can no longer be described as a wave of destruction.Fifteen people were men and women, three of whom went out to perform tasks and died.And Ye Meng is the first of these fifteen people.The one with the highest qualifications, the most proficient mastery of the business, and the highest concealment.Because her qualifications are very good, she has been receiving intensive training and various teachings; of course, it is also because this girl looks a bit too evil.The eyes are too big.And it also has a bit of natural baby fat.As soon as he opens his eyes, he starts to show his cuteness.Even though he is very shrewd in his heart, on the surface it still makes people feel stupid and cute.Anyone who takes a look at this little girl will see that she is dazed and confused, and her brain must not be working very well.But he is naturally lovable.When the eyes are slightly drooped, he is a goblin who brings disaster to the country and the people; but when he opens his eyes, he instantly transforms from a goblin into a cute little lolita.Everyone who sees it wants to pinch it in the face.Such materials, with superb martial arts qualifications, are not willing to be released.Until this time, the top brass thought it was time to give it a try.When Fan Tiantiao made the report, he heard that he was just a little shrimp who had just joined the religion, and with such low strength, the safety factor was very high.So I chose such a relatively safe task and placed it next to Fang Che to experience it first.After all, a line like Fang Che's is of average value.Because the rank is too low, he is only a warrior, and he is only seventeen... See if there is some harvest, if not, then just close the net.It's like playing three poles with or without dates, and let Ye Meng exercise for a while.But Ye Meng is a little confused now.The mission went so smoothly!This Fang Che almost gave him the most relaxed environment to work as an undercover agent, and his reasons were all impeccable!The feeling I give myself is: This is indeed the case.This is indeed how it should be!So even though Ye Meng is not asleep now, it still feels like a dream.confused."We have successfully undercovered Fang Side." "Fang Che has cultivated to about fifth level as a warrior and has excellent qualifications; his training speed is very fast. If he continues at this speed, he will be in the top ten in the garrison martial arts academy's admission competition in one month; the top three is expected." "Fang Che wants to train me in martial arts in order to help me in the future." "..." He simply wrote a few words in secret words and sent them out....Next, Fang Che began to practice. Not only was he diligent, but he also urged Ye Meng to be more strict.Even to the point of perversion.As long as there is any non-standard, he will be beaten or scolded, and he will always say "trash, really unworthy of training, what kind of quality, waste of my food!"’... Ye Meng dared to be angry but did not dare to speak, but did not dare to reveal his true level. He swallowed his anger and practiced hard, and his head was covered with pimples after being scolded."I can't even hold a sword!" "Practice, what do you think I'm going to do?" "It's been three days and you haven't learned the technique yet, you're a waste!" "I can't stand, I can't walk, I can't even run! What do you do for food? Do you think you're just serving tea and water as a maid?" "..." As long as Fang Che takes a break, Night Dream's nightmare will come!That mouth was like a poisonous snake, spraying out all kinds of vicious and attacking words.Cold and vicious."With your qualifications, if you don't make progress, there will be no other use than having children!" "If you don't have high breasts and a curvy butt, you'll be embarrassed to be a concubine if you don't have any spare ribs..." "If you're so stupid, I'll sell you into a brothel!" Ye Meng's heart was burning, and she couldn't help but slap this guy to death many times.This mouth is so poisonous!He was so angry that he wanted to explode, but he instinctively followed Fang Che's instructions. At the end of the day, his back and legs ached, and his brain felt bloated. Well, having a bloated brain was scolded.At night, after serving Fang Che to bed, Ye Meng began to pack up the day's harvest.Then, each action flashed through my mind.Then finally, he stopped in the act of drawing the sword.Suddenly a little surprised.Carefully recall your original movements, and then compare them with your current movements, forming a comparison of figures drawing swords in your mind.He was shocked to find that drawing the sword like this was more comfortable than his original action. Moreover, when the sword was unsheathed, it had lethality. If one practiced to a certain level, the sword energy from drawing the sword would be enough to directly kill the opponent!But I can't do my original habitual movements!Although it is only one move; but if he regains his true strength and uses the sword, his combat power will be increased by more than twice because of this move, which is an unexpected effect!And the lethality is increased even more."How is this possible?" Invisibly, Ye Meng suddenly felt confused.Decided to check it out tomorrow.Could it be that this is the most correct thing?Or is it something that no one has discovered before?What I practiced before was actually not the most correct?
